from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section2Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.setup_layout("Fourier Transform: The Mathematical Prism", [
            "Signals are sums of simple sine waves.",
            "Adding waves creates complex patterns.",
            "Even jagged waves have simple roots."
        ])
        
        # Animations
        axes = Axes(x_range=[0, 2*PI, 1], y_range=[-3, 3, 1], axis_config={"include_tip": False})
        self.place_in_area(axes, 'C1', 'F6', scale_factor=0.55)
        
        def get_wave(freq, color):
            return axes.plot(lambda x: np.sin(freq * x), color=color)

        wave1 = get_wave(1, "#3498DB")
        wave2 = get_wave(3, "#2ECC71")
        wave3 = get_wave(5, "#E74C3C")
        
        # Combined wave (static mobject for initial display)
        combined_func = lambda x: np.sin(x) + 0.33 * np.sin(3*x) + 0.2 * np.sin(5*x)
        combined = axes.plot(combined_func, color=YELLOW)

        # Asset
        icon = SVGMobject("/scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/none.svg")
        self.place_at_grid(icon, "B3", scale_factor=0.5)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color("#3498DB"))
        self.play(Create(wave1))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[1].animate.set_color("#2ECC71"))
        self.play(Create(wave2), Create(wave3))
        self.play(Create(combined))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[2].animate.set_color("#E74C3C"))
        # Fade out complex wave
        self.play(FadeOut(combined))
        # Individual waves flashing
        flashing_waves = VGroup(wave1, wave2, wave3)
        self.play(Indicate(flashing_waves, color="#F1C40F"))
        self.wait(2)
